review_text: Wonderful service and very friendly staff. The whole visit was smooth.
I waited almost an hour and nobody could tell me when my order would be ready.
I was charged twice and my refund request is still unresolved. Please have a manager contact me.
The food made me sick. I am concerned about food safety.
The room was clean, but the booking took a long time to confirm.
Package arrived on time and the quality was good.
